name: Steadfast Group Limited
summary: Steadfast Group Limited operates insurance broker and agency networks in Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Europe, and the United States. It operates through Broking, Underwriting agencies, International, Technology, and Complementary segments. The company offers business insurance products, such as aviation, business pack, business interruption, contract works, corporate travel, cyber, events, farm, marine, management liability, product liability, professional indemnity, public liability, trade credit, and workers compensation; and personal insurance products, including home and contents, landlord, motor, and Strata insurance products.
